description: This file is a tutorial and documentation for using the LiteLLM library to interact with TogetherAI's Llama2 models, including example code snippets for installation, API calls, custom prompt templates, and usage demonstrations.

methods.name: litellm.register_prompt_template
methods.description: Registers a custom prompt template for a specific model in LiteLLM, defining roles and separator formats.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Sends a prompt to a specified model and returns the generated response.
